summary: FD_ED_TC_09_Authentication | Travel Agency Booking | OTP to Agency Email | NOA Upload | Manual Handling
title: Authentication | Travel Agency Booking | OTP to Agency Email | NOA Upload | Manual Handling
description:
Customer booked through a travel agency (Expedia). The email on file is the agency's email, not the customer's. OTP is sent to agency email but customer doesn't have access. Customer uploads a Notice of Authorization (NOA) from the agency. Case sent for manual handling with NOA attached.

Prerequisites:
PNR: TCED08 booked via travel agency (Expedia); Contact email on PNR: bookings@expedia.com (agency email); Customer's personal email: maria.garcia@email.com; 1 leg AC (YYZ?CDG); Delay 5 hrs; Code 42; EU applicable
